text:
Incident Bot: PAGER triggered: kv-cache-eviction.alert (p99 latency > 2s) for pool=hostpool-dedicated-us-east-1 — incident INC-2305-47. Paging eng-oncall. Link: https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-2305-47
Alex: I’m on pager. Joining bridge now. quick check: are we seeing 5xxs or just latency?
Jamie: grabbing logs — 503s not widespread, mostly increased streaming tail latencies. I’m seeing golden path requests to /v1/stream hang at establish >1.5s.
Maria: joining bridge in 30s. posting current alert query results.
Lee: looks like eviction spikes align with a recent autoscaler config change at 04:12 UTC. saw a roll forward in infra-config-ci by @infra-bot.
Priya: taking incident commander until we have mitigation. Alex you run triage, Jamie run tracing, Maria own bridge notes.
Alex: triage notes: KV cache miss rate up ~4x after config change. Clients with large context sizes are thrashing. reconciling with latency graphs now.
Jamie: traces show KV lookup latency increasing, heavy repetitive prefix lookups. putting a quick prom query here:
```
sum(rate(kv_eviction_total[1m])) by (pool)
kv_cache_miss_ratio{pool="hostpool-dedicated-us-east-1"}
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(kv_lookup_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Maria: mitigation idea: temporarily revert autoscaler change + bump pool by 2 nodes to reduce eviction pressure. OpsBot can do a controlled scale within 2 mins?
OpsBot: acknowledged. Scaling hostpool-dedicated-us-east-1 by +2 nodes. ETA ~90s. Actions tracked: OPS-2305-047-scale.
Lee: scale started. also suggest enabling prefix-level caching (disabled in config) as a targeted fix.
Alex: rollback of autoscaler config requested via infra change-sets. @infra-bot can you roll to previous stable?
OpsBot: infra rollback initiated: revert infra-config-ci@r204 -> r203. ETA ~3m.
Jamie: after scale + rollback, p99 latency dropped from ~2.3s to ~0.9s over 4m. KV eviction rate trending down.
Priya: confirmed customer-visible impact: we saw elevated tail latency for streaming customers in a small subset (~2% of calls) for about 18m. No widespread 5xxs. Logging impact to INC-2305-47 summary.
Alex: good. transition to recovery mode. immediate mitigation worked. moving to post-incident follow-up.
Maria: scheduling postmortem — propose EOD tomorrow (business hours) or within 72h. prefer 48h to keep details fresh. Who can facilitate write-up?
Jamie: I’ll own the technical write-up (root cause + graphs) — will drop initial draft into /docs/incidents/INC-2305-47 by EOD tomorrow.
Lee: I’ll PR runbook edits for kv-cache playbook: add a step to check autoscaler change impact and a mitigation snippet for prefix-caching.
Alex: I’ll own action: add a canary/threshold to the autoscaler pipeline so changes don't rollout past a small pct without observing eviction rates.
Priya: ops -> schedule: Maria please create the postmortem doc and calendar invite. Include QE and Platform leads. Set follow-up meeting 48h out.
Maria: created doc: https://docs.internal/rdw/incidents/INC-2305-47 (private). Calendar invite sent for 2023-05-18 15:00 UTC.
Priya: action item table (quick):
- A1: Jamie — draft technical write-up and attach graphs — due 2023-05-17 EOD
- A2: Lee — PR runbook changes (kv-cache playbook) + test steps — due 2023-05-20
- A3: Alex — autoscaler canary/guardrail in CI (add eviction metric check) — due 2023-05-24
- A4: Maria — postmortem doc + invite — done (see link)
- A5: Ops — add an alert to detect autoscaler rollbacks affecting kv eviction — due 2023-05-19
(Owners tagged in doc)
Jamie: will also include a short eval prompt set to track quality regression for streaming after autoscaler changes.
Lee: small runbook snippet I’ll add to the PR: check `kv_cache_miss_ratio` and if p99_latency > 1.5s then consider immediate scale or prefix caching toggle. Will include the `kubectl` step to enable caching via configmap: ```kubectl apply -f kv-prefix-cache-on.yaml```
Alex: note for on-call: update paging thresholds to include eviction-rate sustained > 3x baseline for 5m (previous threshold was 5x). Lowering to catch earlier.
Priya: good call. Maria, please add to the runbook checklist that on-call should do sequence: 1) check eviction metrics, 2) scale pool, 3) revert infra change if correlated, 4) open postmortem doc.
Maria: added checklist to doc and linked to runbook PR.
Priya: closing notes: incident severity was S2 (customer visible latency but mitigated quickly). We'll run the 48h postmortem, keep action item owners accountable in the doc. If anyone wants to add context before the write-up, drop comments in the doc or in this thread. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks all. handing back to next oncall in 30m.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2305-47 closed (resolved). Postmortem scheduled.
